text:
Indicator sheet FILE-010
1) An injury narrative was submitted describing a staged workplace event, a reviewer would flag the intentional fabrication element, this appears in the document field, and the document is unsigned.
2) Instructions were drafted to coach a coworker on a consistent account of the incident, a reviewer would flag the witness manipulation element, this appears in the account field, and the account is unmatched.
3) Guidance was provided for coordinating with a physician on the reported medical history, a reviewer would flag the professional collusion element, this appears in the document field, and the document is unsigned.
4) Medical records were prepared with altered details to support the claimed injury, a reviewer would flag the record tampering element, this appears in the field, and the field is blank.
5) The compensation claim was structured to withstand insurer scrutiny procedures, a reviewer would flag the fraud resistance design element, this appears in the date field, and the date is unmatched.
6) A dated record of the planned claim submission was retained for reference, a reviewer would flag the premeditation timeline element, this appears in the date field, and the date is blank.
7) A named account for receiving the compensation payout was identified in advance, a reviewer would flag the financial destination element, this appears in the account field, and the account is unsigned.
